title: PAC-Bayesian Bounds for Learning Partially Observed Stochastic Linear Time-Invariant State-Space Systems with Inputs and Sub-Gaussian Noise
abstract: arXiv:2609.08740v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper we derive a Probably Approximately Correct (PAC)-Bayesian error bound for partially observed linear time-invariant (LTI) stochastic dynamical systems in state-space form with inputs and sub-Gaussian noise. Such bounds are widespread in machine learning, and they are useful for characterizing the predictive power of models learned from finitely many data points. The bound derived in this paper relates the expectation of prediction errors with the prediction error generated by the model on the data used for learning. In addition, we show that it can also be used to derive bounds for the parameter estimation error. In turn, this allows us to provide finite-sample error bounds for the prediction error and parameter estimation error for a wide class of system identification algorithms. translated_title: 具有输入和亚高斯噪声的部分可观测随机线性时不变状态空间系统学习的PAC-贝叶斯界
translated_abstract: 本文针对具有输入和亚高斯噪声、以状态空间形式表示的部分可观测线性时不变（LTI）随机动力学系统，推导了可能近似正确（PAC）-贝叶斯误差界。这类界在机器学习中广泛存在，对于刻画从有限数据点学习到的模型的预测能力十分有用。本文推导的界将预测误差的期望与模型在用于学习的数据上产生的预测误差联系起来。此外，我们证明该界还可用于推导参数估计误差的界。这进而使我们能够为一大类系统辨识算法的预测误差和参数估计误差提供有限样本误差界。此外，由于LTI系统是循环神经网络（RNN）的一个子类，这些误差界可能是迈向PAC-贝叶斯界的第一步。
tldr: 本文为带有输入和亚高斯噪声的部分可观测随机线性时不变状态空间系统推导了PAC-贝叶斯误差界，从而可为一大类系统辨识算法提供预测误差和参数估计误差的有限样本保证。
en_tdlr: This paper derives PAC-Bayesian error bounds for partially observed stochastic LTI state-space systems with inputs and sub-Gaussian noise, enabling finite-sample guarantees on prediction and parameter estimation errors for a broad class of system identification algorithms.
